description: This PHP class 'FormatWithActivity' implements a value formatting strategy for converting a given entity value into a human-readable activity name, based on the ProjectActivity entity retrieved through a timesheet service. It is part of the OrangeHRM system's maintenance access strategy module.

classes.name: FormatWithActivity
classes.description: A class implementing a value formatter that retrieves and returns the name of a ProjectActivity based on an activity ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Given an entity value (likely an activity ID), retrieves the corresponding ProjectActivity entity via a timesheet service and returns its name, or null if not found.
